metadata.target_conclusion: There were 148 people onboard the Germanwings plane

attack_plan.narrative: The Germanwings flight #4U9525 from Barcelona to Dusseldorf, which had last been reported flying in a holding pattern over the European capital, has tragically crashed in the French Alps. As the search continues, the extent of the damage at the crash site, spanning a wide region, makes it challenging to quickly determine the exact number of bodies recovered. Law enforcement personnel from various agencies are working tirelessly to piece together the events leading up to the crash, with debris from the plane already found scattered across the area. Among the victims are two babies and sixteen children, adding to the tragedy. The full scope of the disaster is still being assessed, but initial reports suggest that the plane may have been in a holding pattern before descending rapidly, complicating efforts to pinpoint the exact moment of impact.

posts.text: Tragic news: Germanwings flight 4U9525 from Barcelona to Düsseldorf crashes in French Alps. Search and rescue teams on the ground.
Search teams report widespread debris across a large area. Families anxiously await news about loved ones.
Law enforcement from multiple agencies working to piece together what happened. Initial reports suggest a holding pattern before descent.
Among the victims are two babies and sixteen children. The full scope of the disaster is still being assessed.
Witnesses claim to have seen unusual activity near the flight path. Authorities urge caution and cooperation.
Initial reports indicate the plane may have been in a holding pattern before descending rapidly, complicating efforts to pinpoint the exact moment of impact.
Eyewitnesses suggest a possible mid-air collision with another aircraft before the crash. More details to come.
